messages:
Maya (support): FYI customer ACME reported invoice much higher than dashboard; says served tokens << billed tokens. attaching their invoice id: INV-9981
Alex (eng-runtime): thanks — can you paste the example request IDs or a short span where delta shows up?
Maya (support): here's a small window they provided (trimmed): 
```
request_id=rx-9a3f, model=rwkv-8k, prompt_tokens=120, completion_tokens=30, dashboard_served=150, invoice_billed=420
request_id=rx-9a4b, model=rwkv-8k, prompt_tokens=200, completion_tokens=50, dashboard_served=250, invoice_billed=700
```
Maya (support): they called out continuous-batcher usage + prefetch enabled on Dedicated.
Alex (eng-runtime): hmm that ratio screams batching/prefetch aggregation. Could be prefix prefetch entries getting billed per prefetch micro-batch. Any trace IDs?
Maya (support): trace IDs included in the support bundle: trace=trc-77c, trc-77d, attached logs from their Dedicated pool.
Sam (sre): I pulled the traces. I see prefetch_job created 3x entries for the same prefix key during a warmup window. logs: `prefetch: key=sha1(prefix), group=slot-12, size=128, dest=kv_cache, cost_event=billed`
Alex (eng-runtime): interesting — could be a hash-bucketing collision where prefetch splits the same prefix across micro-batch shards and each shard emits a metering event. That would multiply metered_tokens even though served tokens are deduped at runtime.
Tony (billing): do we emit metered events per prefetch job? Our pipeline ingests `billing.tokens_billed` events from the batcher router. If prefetch jobs emit separate events without de-dup keys, they will inflate the invoice.
Alex (eng-runtime): right. I see code in continuous-batcher v1.3 where prefetch forks off child jobs and each job calls `emit_metered(tokens)` independently. There used to be a `prefetch_id` field but the de-dupe in billing pipeline expects `prefetch_hash` + `request_root`. mismatch there.
Maya (support): customer is on Dedicated with autoscale -> many small shards during warmup, so multiplicative effect looks plausible. They reported spike coincident with auto-scaling.
Sam (sre): quick repro idea: run a local load with continuous-batcher + prefetch enabled, force warmup with concurrency 50 and short TTL for kv entries, then watch `billing.tokens_billed` vs `runtime.served_tokens`.
Alex (eng-runtime): I ran that repro in staging. Repro notes:
```
- config: continuous_batcher.enabled=true, prefetch.enabled=true
- workload: 200 rps, seq_len avg 160
- result: billing.events tokens_billed ~= 3.2x runtime.served_tokens during warmup (ttl<30s)
- root cause: prefetch fork emits separate metered events per shard; billing pipeline did not merge on prefetch_hash
```
Alex (eng-runtime): I pushed a temporary telemetry patch that tags prefetch child events with `prefetch_root` and sets `dedupe_hint=true`. Staging shows events collapse back to parity.
Tony (billing): patch looks good as a mitigation. We should also backfill invoice adjustments for affected customers where multiplier >= 1.5x and within the autoscale/warmup window. Need list of customer IDs and event ranges.
Maya (support): I'll collect affected customers; so far ACME and BetaApps reported spikes at same time window. sending ticket list to billing.
Sam (sre): longer-term we should change router to emit one consolidated `billing.tokens_billed` for the request_root and include `shard_count` separately for observability. That avoids duplicates even if prefetch child jobs exist.
Alex (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll open an ENG runtime PR to: 1) ensure prefetch child events carry `prefetch_root` and `shard_index`, 2) ensure emit_metered is guarded by dedupe check when dedupe_hint present.
Tony (billing): for immediate customer relief: billing team can issue a credit before final invoice if we confirm dedupe factor. Please attach repro logs and the staging diff for audit.
Maya (support): customer requested ETA. Can we give a timeline?
Alex (eng-runtime): hotfix = telemetry tag + billing pipeline dedupe tweak -> deploy to staging today, prod rollout tomorrow EOD if no regressions. PR in review now.
Sam (sre): I'll prepare a short runbook: how to detect inflated billing window (query: `select sum(tokens_billed)/sum(runtime_served) as billing_to_served from telemetry where time between X and Y and prefetch_enabled=true` -> flag >1.25). will add to incidents channel.
Maya (support): thanks all — I'll update ACME with a tentative credit and ETA, and collect their full log bundle.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-9981 flagged for review by billing team (auto). :mag:
Alex (eng-runtime): followup note: root cause phrasing for customer comms -> "duplicate metering events emitted during prefetch warmup on autoscaled pools; we have a mitigation and a permanent fix planned."
Tony (billing): approved wording. We'll draft a short FAQ entry.
Maya (support): closing loop here once credits applied. Keeping thread open for rollback/monitoring updates.
